A '''Queen's jam''' is a [[Black Forest]]-tier [[food]].

== Recipe ==
Four ''Queen's jams'' are produced in a level 1 [[Cauldron]] with:

* {{Item link|Raspberries|8}}
* {{Item link|Blueberries|6}}

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
* {{Item link|Black Forest Buffet Platter}}

== Notes ==
* Queen's jam provides the second-highest stamina gain in the [[Black Forest]] at 40, second to [[Carrot Soup]] at 45.

== Trivia ==
* Queen's jam is a popular jam in Scandinavia, made by mixing raspberries and blueberries, both sweet and common, in the region.
* ''Drottningsylt'', or queen’s jam, is popular for delicacies such as ''plättar'' and Swedish pancakes.

==Other locations==
Other than crafting, Sausages can be found:
* In [[Loot chest#Infested Mine Treasure Ches|treasure chests]] at [[Infested Mine]]s.

* Sausages can be given to tamed [[wolf|Wolves]].

'''Serpent Meat''' is a guaranteed drop from [[Serpent]]s, and drops in quantities of 6-7. It can be cooked on an [[Iron Cooking Station]] to obtain '''Cooked Serpent Meat''' and be eaten or crafted into other foods. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Serpent|0star=6-7|px=70}} |stars=0}} == Usage == === Crafting === ==== For Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Cooked Serpent Meat|nolink=1}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long ==== For Cooked Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Serpent Stew}} * {{Item link|Sailor's Bounty}} Unlike most other foods made from meat, Serpent Meat has to be cooked on an Iron cooking station first to be crafted into other foods. == Notes == * Serpent Meat floats. It can remain floating for a considerable period. If the player kills a Serpent during a storm but cannot pick up the meat at the time, return as soon as possible and the meat may still be recoverable. * As [[Serpent Stew]] provides more health and stamina, eating the meat is not ideal unless in excess of it. * The stew's constituent ingredients are easily obtainable, with [[Mushroom]]s able to be foraged from [[Meadows]] and [[Black Forest]]s, while the [[Honey]] can be obtained from [[Beehive]]s. * A player eating Cooked Serpent Meat may want to limit the amount of it they carry, as each one is much heavier than any other foods. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Мясо змея]] [[cs:Maso z hada]]

You take less damage from poison. | id = MeadPoisonResist | type = Mead | source = [[Fermenter]] | usage = Drinking | buy = | sell = | weight = 1.0 | stack = 10 | teleport = Yes | materials = * [[Mead Base: Poison Resistance]] x1 | quantity = 6 | health = | stamina = | duration = 600 | healing = | effect = Very resistant vs. Poison | cooldown = 600 }} |-| Mead base= {{infobox item | title = Mead base: Poison resistance | image = Mead base: Poison resistance.png | description = Needs to be fermented. | id = MeadBasePoisonResist | type = Mead Base | source = [[Mead Ketill]] | usage = [[Fermenter]] | buy = | sell = | weight = 1.0 | stack = 1 | teleport = Yes | materials = * [[Honey]] x10 * [[Thistle]] x5 * [[Neck Tail]] x1 * [[Coal]] x10 }}
'''Poison resistance mead''' is a [[Black Forest]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Poison resistance'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Poison resistance'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: *{{Item_Link|Honey|10}} *{{Item_Link|Thistle|5}} *{{Item_Link|Neck tail|1}} *{{Item_Link|Coal|10}} Six ''Poison resistance meads'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Upon consumption, it grants "very resistant" to [[Damage types#Poison|poison damage]] for 10 minutes, reducing [[poison|poison effect]] duration and tick damage by 75%. The poison resistance only works on poison applied while the resistance is active. A player drinking the mead after they were poisoned will not reduce the effect duration or tick damage. You typically want to save this for directly before entering combat with a poisonous enemy to get the most time out of the potion. This potion does not last very long so you may want to bring a few per trip. == Notes == * It is recommended to craft some before entering the [[Swamp]] for the first time to counteract the [[poison]] effect ** Other poison-resistant gear requires {{Item link|Root (item)|3=Roots|image=Root.png}}, which are only obtainable by killing [[Abomination]]s. * The Poison resistance mead's "very resistant" effect overrides the "resistant" effect of the [[Root Mask]]. * While the Poison resistance mead has a stronger effect than the [[Root Set|Root Mask]], The [[Root Set|Root Mask's]] buff never expires. {{FoodsNav}} [[cs:Medovina proti jedu]] [[ru:Медовуха-антидот]]

'''Serpent Stew''' is a [[Swamp]]-tier food. 

== Recipe ==
''Serpent Stew'' is produced in a level 2 [[Cauldron]] with:

* {{Item link|Mushroom|1}}
* {{Item link|Cooked Serpent Meat|1}}
* {{Item link|Honey|2}}

As of the Hearth & Home update, to cook Serpent Stew, it is required to have a Cauldron with at least one upgrade, such as the [[Spice Rack]] (which is normally the easiest one to craft).

== Notes ==
* Serpent Stew provides very high health compared to most other food items in its tier at 80, and continues to be a useful food source all the way into the [[Mistlands]].
* Serpent Stew is also tied with [[Meat Platter]] and [[Honey Glazed Chicken]] in terms of health and stamina gain, but falls short in its healing, with the two Mistlands-tier foods healing for 5 hp/tick, whereas Serpent Stew heals for 4 hp/tick.
* Despite being made from Cooked Serpent Meat which weighs 10 units, the stew only weighs 1 unit.

'''Tasty mead''' is a [[Black Forest]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Tasty'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Tasty'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: * {{Item Link|Honey|10}} * {{Item Link|Raspberries|10}} * {{Item Link|Blueberries|5}} Six ''Tasty meads'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Grants the following effects when consumed: * Health regen -50% * Stamina regen +100% Like all other meads, the player cannot consume another tasty mead while the effect is active, but unlike the stamina meads, there is no cooldown. Once the effect ends, a second mead can be immediately consumed. The stamina regeneration effect will be interrupted if the user performs any action that normally consumes stamina, such as attacking or sprinting. Tasty mead may be useful in boss fights due to its short cooldown period and dramatic restorative effects. Note: "-50% health regen" does not drain health, it merely slows regeneration. ==Other locations== Other than brewing the meads, they can be found by destroying [[Dvergr Barrel]]s or [[Ancient Pot]]s. == See also == * [[Minor Stamina Mead]] * [[Medium Stamina Mead]] * [[Lingering Stamina Mead]] {{FoodsNav}} [[cs:Chutná medovina]] [[ru:Вкусная медовуха]]

It can be cooked directly on an [[Iron Cooking Station]], but not on a wooden [[Cooking Station]], to obtain '''Cooked Seeker Meat''' or [[Coal]] if overcooked. It is used directly in food recipes at the [[Food Preparation Table]]. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Seeker|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4|px=50}} {{drop row|item=Seeker soldier|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4|px=50}} }} == Usage == === Crafting === ==== For Seeker meat ==== * {{Item link|Cooked seeker meat|nolink=1}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long * {{Item link|Meat Platter}} (from {{Item link|Uncooked Meat Platter}}) * {{Item link|Seeker Aspic}} ==== For Cooked seeker meat ==== * {{Item link|Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands}} Cooked seeker meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Seeker meat as ingredient, or vice versa. == Notes == * For magic-oriented players, the [[Seeker Aspic]] is the best Eitr-granting food available in the Mistlands. * Because there are many [[Seeker]]s in the Mistlands and the production of [[Meat Platter]]s tends to be bottlenecked behind the rarer [[Hare Meat]], Cooked seeker meat can serve as a good food option when the player is returning to older biomes or working on base building. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Мясо искателя]] [[cs:Maso Hledačů]]

* As of [[Version history|patch 0.213.4]], all Royal jelly piles in Infested Mines will respawn every four hours. Most of the piles have a permanent visual indicator on the ceiling above them (a hanging, dripping stalactite of Royal jelly which is purely aesthetic) to indicate their location, so players can easily find where the piles are located in-between respawns.
** However, in versions of the game prior to 0.213.4, the pickable Royal jelly piles in Infested Mines permanently disappeared once picked: any piles that were picked in versions prior to 0.213.4 are permanently gone and will never respawn.
* In addition to the respawning piles inside Infested Mines, there are two additional ways to encounter endless quantities of them:
** The Mistlands-specific [[Events]], one of which spawns [[Seeker Brood]]s. Both Mistlands events have specific biome requirements; in particular, neither can occur in the [[Meadows]].
** The [[The Queen|boss of the Mistlands]] is capable of spawning Seeker broods indefinitely. To access her, players will need either a completed [[Sealbreaker]] or (if summoning again) a sacrifice of three [[Seeker Soldier Trophy|Seeker soldier trophies]].
